title: 第17章 真的很香第18章 约斗
slug: 剑道圣体的我只想躺平
content_zh:
刚走没多远，就听后边传来破口大骂声：“哪个王八蛋偷我五彩灵鸡。”
秦峰哪里敢回头，撒腿就跑。
在外围望风的柳梦瑶问道：“师兄，得手了吗？”
秦峰道：“快跑，动静太大，被六师伯发现了。”
回到秦峰小院，二人还喘着粗气，然后相视一笑。
烧水拔毛，一气呵成，秦峰十分的娴熟，很快就将两只五彩灵鸡处理好，先吃一只，留一只下顿吃。
秦峰将鸡放在锅里，又放了一些蘑菇跟菜叶，剩下就只有等待了。
灵兽园外
几名长老全都被叫到了这里，穆无双有些不耐烦道：“六师兄，大晚上的你不睡觉，把我们都喊到这里干什么？”
“难道是让我们来欣赏你培养的妖兽？”
楼万里道：“是啊，老六，你今天要不给个说法，我可不干。”
六长老面色阴沉道：“我的五彩灵鸡被偷了两只，应该是内门弟子干的。”
楼万里一脸不屑道：“老六，你是没睡醒吧？”
“这灵兽园外围可都是我们几个长老亲自布的防护阵，即便是我们亲自破阵，也要闹出动静。”
“你说有人会在你发现之前，破阵把鸡偷走了？”
“不会是又找借口让我们给你做免费苦力吧？”
六长老道：“你们自己看！”
众人顺着六长老指的方向查看一番，虽然阵法已经被修复，但能看得出之前确实被破开过。
而且两只灵鸡被斩杀的地方还有血迹。
穆无双有些惊讶道：“好凌厉的剑意，这是裂地剑。

而且已经达到了化境。”
“难怪能这么轻易破开我们联手布置的防护阵。”
就算以她的天赋，也只是将裂地剑练到化境而已。
对方是何等天赋？
六长老道：“我平时也不参与宗门的事，找你们过来就是问问，宗门内哪个弟子能达到这种程度？”
众人都齐齐把目光看向了穆无双，这一幕让六长老不解，难道大家都知道答案了，心这么齐吗？
穆无双道：“你们看我干什么？不是我，我想吃灵鸡，过来管六师兄要就行了，也不用偷。”
楼万里道：“你是不用偷，你徒弟呢？”
其他人也都一脸笃定的看着穆无双，穆无双想了想，然后摇头：“不可能！”
“我问你们，你们能将剑技练到化境的有几门？”
众人都老脸一红，除了掌门跟穆无双，他们无一人将剑技练到化境。
到化境，至少要几百年的时间，而且还是天赋卓绝的情况。
穆无双又道：“秦峰的万剑归宗已达化境，而且我从来没见他用过诛天剑诀。”
“平常人将一门剑技炼到化境都难如登天，所以不可能是他！”
众人也都点点头，因为这是事实，他们都深有体会。
那又是谁呢？
六长老道：“会不会是宁飞？”
掌门弟子宁飞是年轻一辈的大师兄，天赋卓绝，二十岁的时候就将剑技练到化境。
楼万里道：“宁飞为人正派，应该不是他。”
六长老道：“既然目前没有线索，那我们就再加固一下这阵法，明天再继续查。”
content_en:
After walking not far, I heard yelling curses from behind: "Which bastard stole my colorful chicken."
If Qin Feng dared to look back, he would just run away.
Liu Mengyao, who was watching from the outside, asked, "Senior brother, have you succeeded?"
Qin Feng said: "Run quickly, there is too much movement, and the sixth uncle discovered us."
Returning to Qin Feng's courtyard, the two of them were still breathing heavily, then looked at each other and smiled.
He boiled water and pulled out the feathers in one go. Qin Feng was very skillful and quickly took care of the two colorful chickens. He ate one first and kept the other for next meal.
Qin Feng put the chicken in the pot and added some mushrooms and vegetable leaves. All that was left was to wait.
Outside the Spiritual Beast Garden
Several elders were all called here. Mu Wushuang said impatiently: "Sixth Senior Brother, you don't sleep at night, why did you call us here?"
"Are you asking us to admire the monsters you cultivated?"
Lou Wanli said: "Yes, Lao Liu, if you don't give me an explanation today, I won't do it."
The Sixth Elder said with a gloomy expression, "Two of my colorful chickens were stolen. It must have been done by an inner disciple."
Lou Wanli said with disdain: "Lao Liu, you're not awake yet, are you?"
"The perimeter of this spirit beast garden is surrounded by a protective formation set up by us elders. Even if we break the formation ourselves, we will still make a fuss."
"You said someone would break the formation and steal the chicken before you found out?"
"You're not making another excuse to ask us to do free labor for you, are you?"
The Sixth Elder said: "See for yourselves!"
Everyone looked in the direction pointed by the Sixth Elder. Although the formation had been repaired, it could be seen that it had indeed been broken before.
Moreover, there were blood stains where the two spiritual chickens were beheaded.
Mu Wushuang was a little surprised and said: "What a sharp sword intent, this is the Earth Splitting Sword.
And it has reached the transformation state. "
"No wonder it can be so easy to break through the protective formation we jointly set up."
Even with her talent, she could only practice the Earth Splitting Sword to the transformation state.
How talented is the other party?
The Sixth Elder said: "I usually don't participate in the affairs of the sect. I came to you just to ask, which disciple in the sect can reach this level?"
Everyone looked at Mu Wushuang. This scene puzzled the Sixth Elder. Could it be that everyone knew the answer and were so united?
Mu Wushuang said: "What do you think I'm doing? It's not me. I want to eat the spiritual chicken. Just come here and take care of Sixth Brother. There's no need to steal it."
Lou Wanli said: "You don't have to steal, where is your apprentice?"
Everyone else also looked at Mu Wushuang with determination. Mu Wushuang thought for a while, then shook his head: "Impossible!"
"Let me ask you, how many sword skills can you practice to the realm of transformation?"
Everyone blushed. Except for the leader and Mu Wushuang, none of them had practiced their sword skills to the level of transformation.
It will take at least hundreds of years to reach the transformation state, and it is still a case of extraordinary talent.
Mu Wushuang added: "Qin Feng's Ten Thousand Swords Guizong has reached the realm of transformation, and I have never seen him use the Heaven-Destroying Sword Technique."
"It's difficult for an ordinary person to refine a sword skill to the realm of transformation, so it can't be him!"
Everyone also nodded, because this is a fact and they all understand it deeply.
Then who is it?
The Sixth Elder asked: "Could it be Ning Fei?"
The head disciple, Ning Fei, is a senior brother of the younger generation. He is extremely talented and has mastered his sword skills to the realm of transformation when he was twenty years old.
Lou Wanli said: "Ning Fei is a decent man, so it shouldn't be him."
The Sixth Elder said: "Since there are currently no clues, let's strengthen the formation and continue the investigation tomorrow."
